sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: In Your Face · An enemy sharing the swarm’s space makes attacks against other targets with disadvantage. It takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage if it attacks a creature besides the swarm.
Swarm · The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through any opening that admits one Tiny skitterling. It cannot heal or gain temporary hit points.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Claws · Reach 0 ft., one target. At 18 HP or fewer, the hit deals 7 (2d6) slashing damage. Any hit requires a DC 10 Constitution save. Failure blinds the target until the start of its next turn. Immunity to poison damage or the poisoned condition makes that save an automatic success.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: MCDM, Flee, Mortals! public preview, pp. 5 and 9. Unaligned. Proficiency bonus +2. No languages.
The Goblins chapter places outlaw goblin encounters in deserts, forests, and underground. The preview gives no separate natural habitat for this beast.
Goblins train skitterlings to attack faces. Put the swarm in an enemy’s space to pressure that enemy into attacking it, then use Claws to hinder the target’s next attacks.

target.name: Charmed
target.description: You cannot attack or use harmful effects against the charmer, who has advantage on social checks involving you.

target.name: Frightened
target.description: While you can see the source of your fear, your attacks and ability checks have disadvantage. You cannot willingly move closer to it.

target.name: Grappled
target.description: Your speed becomes 0. The grapple ends if you are moved out of the grappler’s reach.

target.name: Paralyzed
target.description: You cannot act, move, or speak, and nearby attacks that hit you are critical hits.

target.name: Petrified
target.description: You turn into a solid, inanimate substance and cannot act or move. You have resistance to all damage.

target.name: Prone
target.description: You can crawl or stand up. Your attacks have disadvantage, and nearby attackers have advantage against you.

target.name: Restrained
target.description: Your speed is 0. Your attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage, and attacks against you have advantage.

target.name: Stunned
target.description: You cannot act and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attackers have advantage against you.

target.name: Disadvantage
target.description: Roll two d20s and use the lower roll.

target.name: Poisoned
target.description: Your attack rolls and ability checks have disadvantage.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: An enormous eight-legged spider with blade-edged legs and a broad back that can carry a goblin archery platform.

sections.title: Senses
lines: blindsight 10 ft.
darkvision 60 ft.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +6 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 2d6 + 4 piercing plus 2d6 poison
Bladed Leg · melee · +6 to hit · reach 10 ft. · 2d6 + 4 slashing

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Baby Burst · At death, release one Swarm of Insects (spiders). It acts on the War Spider’s initiative count.

Rider Launcher · An allied rider jumping off the spider can long jump 30 ft. or high jump 15 ft. from a standstill or running start. The rider has advantage on its first melee weapon attack that turn.
Spider Climb · The spider can climb difficult surfaces and traverse ceilings without a check.
Web Walker · Webbing does not restrict the spider’s movement.
Wide Back · Two Small or Tiny riders can share a space on the spider. It carries up to 18 Small or 64 Tiny riders.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Web Spray · Each creature in a 15-ft. cube must make a DC 13 Dexterity save or be restrained. A creature can use an action to attempt a DC 13 Strength or Dexterity check, freeing itself or a creature within its reach on a success.

Trample (Recharge 6) · Move up to its speed through other creatures’ spaces. Make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space the spider enters. A hit removes that creature’s reactions until the start of its next turn.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: MCDM, Flee, Mortals! public preview, pp. 5 and 9. Unaligned. Proficiency bonus +2. No languages.
The Goblins chapter places outlaw goblin encounters in deserts, forests, and underground. The preview gives no separate natural habitat for this beast.
Goblins use the spider as a battle mount, with archers above and riders that jump into melee. Use Web Spray to hold a group in place or Trample to move through an enemy line.

target.description: Conjure a cube of webs that hinders movement. A creature caught in it can become Restrained.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: An enormous spider that can carry goblin riders and hide smaller spiders in its body.

sections.title: Classification
lines: Huge Beast, unaligned

sections.title: Other statistics
lines: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Baby Burst. When the spider dies, a Swarm of Spiders (MCDM) emerges and acts on its initiative count.
Rider Launcher. Allied riders can jump off up to 30 ft. horizontally or 15 ft. vertically without a running start. The jumping rider has advantage on their first melee weapon attack that turn.
Spider Climb. Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing doesn't restrict movement.
Wide Back. Two Small or Tiny riders can share a space on its back. Capacity is 18 Small riders or 72 Tiny riders.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison.
Bladed Leg. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing.
Web Spray. Creatures in a 15-ft. cube must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or be restrained by webs. A creature can spend an action on a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity check to free itself or a creature within reach.
Trample (recharge 6). Move up to the spider's speed through other creatures' spaces, treating them as difficult terrain. It can make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space it enters. A hit prevents that creature from taking reactions until the start of its next turn.
